submittal of a Forest Grant Application. Motion carried.
RESULT: APPROVED [UNANIMOUS]
MOVER: Robert Stephens, Ward 3
SECONDER: Nelson Pasha, Ward 2
AYES: Viau, Priest, Gewiss, Pasha, Stephens, Mielke
C. Update: City Municipal Drinking Water - East System - PFAS.
Water samples were collected and tested in August. The twelve-month sampling trend is shown in the
table below. Due to an exceedance of the MCL in Well #1’s samples we will need to reissue a public
notice to the East System customers only. We continue to blend the water from all three Maple Ridge
wells. Manganese in the blended water remains well below the health advisory level.

carried.
Motion by Gewiss and seconded by Viau to approve Ordinance No. 2026-01: An Ordinance repealing and
recreating Article VI of Chapter 78 of the Code of Ordinances, City of Mosinee, Wisconsin relating to bicycles,
electric bicycles, electric scooters, and similar devices. Motion carried.
